content: I created a pull request for Lagrange inversion, a technique that frequently appears in research papers and competitive programming.　https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/43871

I have put in some work (about 90 comments), to get this PR #43871, closer to mathlib standard. It is based on an article by Surya and Warnke, giving an elementary induction proof for the Lagrange inversion formula for formal power series. I would appreciate if someone more experienced would take a look. Some comments were given before by @Jiaxi Mo and @Weiyi Wang and those have been addressed.

Any update on this PR #43871 regarding the Lagrange inversion formula for characteristic zero fields (or more generally commutative rings with HasUniqueDiv)? In combinatorics, it seems to me the result is most commonly applied to rings containing the rational numbers, although one could use universal coefficients to remove this assumption.

Thanks for following up! I've implemented the TODO.

The original motivation was to make the formulations used in competitive programming and papers usable in Mathlib. Since this PR has gotten quite large, I would like to limit the scope here.
